testCases.title: Login with valid credentials - Student

testCases.title: Login with valid credentials - Teacher
testCases.description: Verify that a teacher can successfully login with valid credentials
testCases.expectedResult: User is redirected to /cms/dashboard and session is created

testCases.title: Login with valid credentials - Admin
testCases.description: Verify that an admin can successfully login with valid credentials
testCases.expectedResult: User is redirected to /cms/dashboard and session is created

testCases.title: Login with empty username
testCases.description: Verify that login fails when username is empty
testCases.expectedResult: Validation error message 'Vui lòng nhập tên đăng nhập.' is displayed

testCases.title: Login with empty password
testCases.description: Verify that login fails when password is empty
testCases.expectedResult: Validation error message 'Vui lòng nhập mật khẩu.' is displayed

testCases.title: Login with invalid credentials
testCases.description: Verify that login fails with invalid username or password

testCases.title: Remember Me functionality
testCases.description: Verify that Remember Me checkbox creates persistent cookie
testCases.expectedResult: Authentication cookie has extended expiration time (120 minutes)

testCases.title: Logout functionality
testCases.description: Verify that logout clears session and authentication
testCases.expectedResult: User is redirected to login page, session is cleared, authentication cookie is removed

testCases.title: Return URL after login - Valid URL

testSteps: Navigate to /lms/dashboard (should redirect to login with returnUrl)
testCases.expectedResult: User is redirected to the original return URL

testCases.title: Return URL validation - Block physical paths

testCases.expectedResult: Return URL is ignored, user redirected to default dashboard

testCases.description: Verify that students cannot access CMS via return URL
testCases.expectedResult: Return URL is ignored, student redirected to /lms/dashboard

testCases.title: Demo account auto-fill - Student
testCases.description: Verify that demo account button auto-fills student credentials
testCases.expectedResult: Username and password fields are auto-filled with demo credentials

testCases.title: Password toggle visibility
testCases.description: Verify that password can be shown/hidden via toggle button
testCases.expectedResult: Password field type toggles between 'password' and 'text'

testCases.title: Load CMS Dashboard - Admin
testCases.description: Verify that admin can load CMS dashboard with statistics
testCases.expectedResult: Dashboard loads with statistics: TotalCourses, TotalStudents, TotalLessons, AverageScore, etc.

testCases.title: CMS Dashboard - Refresh button
testCases.description: Verify that refresh button reloads dashboard data
testCases.expectedResult: Dashboard data is reloaded and statistics are updated

testCases.title: CMS Dashboard - Recent courses display
testCases.description: Verify that recent courses are displayed (max 6)

testCases.title: CMS Dashboard - Error handling
testCases.description: Verify error handling when service fails

testCases.expectedResult: Error message 'Không thể nạp số liệu dashboard.' is displayed

testCases.title: CMS Dashboard - Admin menu visibility
testCases.description: Verify that admin menu is visible for admin users

testCases.title: CMS Dashboard - Notification count
testCases.description: Verify that notification count is displayed
testCases.expectedResult: Notification count badge is shown (or 0 if no notifications)

testCases.title: Load Course List

preconditions: User is authenticated as admin or teacher
testCases.expectedResult: Course list is displayed with columns: Year/Semester, Class/Subject, Teacher, Content Status, Students, Actions

testCases.title: Course List - Search by subject name
testCases.description: Verify that search filter works for subject name
testSteps: Enter subject name in search field
testCases.expectedResult: Only courses matching the search term are displayed

testCases.title: Course List - Filter by Year
testCases.description: Verify that year filter works correctly
testSteps: Select a year from Year dropdown
testCases.expectedResult: Only courses for selected year are displayed

testCases.title: Course List - Filter by Semester
testCases.description: Verify that semester filter works correctly
testCases.expectedResult: Only courses for semester 1 are displayed

testCases.title: Course List - Filter by Status
testCases.description: Verify that course status filter works correctly
testSteps: Select 'Đã xuất bản' from Status dropdown
testCases.expectedResult: Only courses with PUBLISHED status are displayed

testCases.title: Course List - Pagination
testCases.description: Verify that GridView pagination works correctly
preconditions: Course list has more than 20 items
testCases.expectedResult: Pagination works, 20 items per page, page navigation changes displayed items

testCases.title: Course List - Empty result
testCases.description: Verify empty state message when no courses match filter
testCases.expectedResult: Message 'Không có môn học lớp phù hợp bộ lọc.' is displayed

testCases.title: Open Course Settings Modal

preconditions: Course with existing content is in list

testCases.title: Save Course Settings - Valid data
testCases.description: Verify that course settings can be saved with valid data

testCases.title: Save Course Settings - Invalid Passing Score
testCases.description: Verify that invalid passing score is rejected
testCases.expectedResult: Error message 'Thiết lập môn học không hợp lệ.' is displayed, modal stays open

testCases.title: Save Course Settings - Negative Passing Score
testCases.description: Verify that negative passing score is rejected
testCases.expectedResult: Error message 'Thiết lập môn học không hợp lệ.' is displayed, modal stays open

testCases.title: Save Course Settings - Non-numeric Passing Score
testCases.description: Verify that non-numeric passing score is rejected
testCases.expectedResult: Error message 'Thiết lập môn học không hợp lệ.' is displayed, modal stays open

testCases.title: Close Course Settings Modal
testCases.description: Verify that modal can be closed without saving
testCases.expectedResult: Modal closes, changes are discarded, no success message shown

testCases.title: Ensure Workspace - Create new course
testCases.description: Verify that new course workspace can be created
preconditions: ClassSubject without OnlineCourse exists in list
testSteps: Find row with 'Chưa khởi tạo' status

testCases.title: Navigate to Course Content Editor
testCases.description: Verify that 'Soạn bài' button navigates to content editor

testCases.title: Course Status Labels
testCases.description: Verify that course status labels are displayed correctly
testSteps: Verify status badges for different courses
Check: 'Chưa khởi tạo', 'Bản nháp', 'Đã xuất bản', 'Lưu trữ'
testCases.expectedResult: Status badges display correct labels and colors for each status

testCases.title: Load User List
testCases.description: Verify that user list loads successfully
testCases.expectedResult: User list is displayed with columns: Avatar, Name, Email, Code, Status, Last Login, Actions

testCases.title: User Management - Admin only access

preconditions: User is authenticated as teacher (not admin)

testCases.title: Create New User - Valid data

testCases.title: Create User - Missing required fields

testCases.title: Create User - No role selected

testCases.title: User Search - By name

testCases.title: User Filter - By Role

testCases.title: User Filter - By Status
testCases.description: Verify that user can be filtered by status
testCases.expectedResult: Only users with selected status are displayed

testCases.title: User Initials Display

testCases.title: User Status Labels

modules.name: Error Handling
modules.description: Error page and error handling tests

testCases.title: 404 Not Found page
testCases.description: Verify that 404 page is displayed for non-existent routes
testCases.expectedResult: 404 Not Found page is displayed

testCases.title: 403 Forbidden page
testCases.description: Verify that 403 page is displayed for unauthorized access
preconditions: User is authenticated but lacks permission
testCases.expectedResult: 403 Forbidden page is displayed

testCases.title: General Error page
testCases.description: Verify that general error page is displayed for unhandled errors
testCases.expectedResult: General error page is displayed

testCases.title: Login Full PostBack
testCases.description: Verify that login triggers full PostBack
testCases.expectedResult: Full page PostBack occurs, form data is submitted to server

testCases.title: Course Settings Partial PostBack
testCases.description: Verify that course settings modal uses UpdatePanel
testCases.expectedResult: Partial PostBack occurs via UpdatePanel, only modal content updates

testCases.title: GridView RowCommand PostBack
testCases.description: Verify that GridView row commands trigger PostBack
testCases.expectedResult: PostBack occurs with CommandName and CommandArgument

testCases.title: Session creation on login
testCases.description: Verify that session is created when user logs in
testCases.expectedResult: Session is created, authentication cookie is set, user can access protected pages

testCases.title: Session clear on logout
testCases.description: Verify that session is cleared when user logs out
testCases.expectedResult: Session is cleared, authentication cookie is removed, user is redirected to login

testCases.title: Session persistence across pages
testCases.description: Verify that session persists across page navigation
testCases.expectedResult: Session persists, user remains authenticated across all pages

testCases.title: Session timeout behavior
testCases.description: Verify that session expires after timeout (120 minutes)
testSteps: Wait for session timeout (120 minutes or simulate)
testCases.expectedResult: Session is expired, user is redirected to login
